column3: What it does
Front door of BMAD: tells you which skill to use next and sets the method up.
Business analyst who researches the market and competitors and pins down requirements.
Runs a brainstorming session with different creative techniques.
Has several personas poke holes in a half-formed idea until you can act on it or drop it.
Critiques a first draft and proposes one stronger revision.
Turns a transcript, voice memo or long document into cited notes the agents can use.
Product manager who writes and reviews the product requirements document (PRD).
Product owner who turns ideas into epics, user stories and acceptance criteria.
Lets several team personas discuss one question together, like a meeting.
Coaches you through writing or checking a planning document.
Checks code against its spec: which requirements hold, which are broken, which are missing.
Forces a design conversation before any new feature is built.
Turns a spec into a step-by-step build plan before code is touched.
Decision-grade research on a topic or repo, with sources.
Builds a knowledge graph of a codebase so agents understand how it fits together.
Answers questions about the codebase using that graph.
Gives a deep-dive explanation of one file, function or module.
Maps the business flows (domains, steps) hidden in the code.
Explains what a change or PR touches and how risky it is.
Writes an onboarding guide for someone new to the project.
Opens the knowledge graph as an interactive map in your browser.
Turns a notes or wiki folder into a searchable knowledge graph.
Looks inside an app you don't have the code for and explains how a feature works, with evidence.
System architect who leads technical design.
Records the key architecture decisions in one short document.
Designs stable APIs and module boundaries (REST, GraphQL, types).
Gives a shared vocabulary for designing simple, deep modules.
Scans the codebase for refactors worth doing and reports them.
Produces a threat model: what can go wrong, who can attack it, what must hold.
Helps pick the right Cloudflare product for an app, API, storage or security need.
Plans which Stripe products to use and how billing fits the app before coding.
UX designer and UI specialist persona.
Writes DESIGN.md (how it looks) and EXPERIENCE.md (how it behaves).
Maps a Figma file's screens, components and design tokens.
Proposes a full design system for your product: layout pattern, style, colors, fonts, do's and don'ts.
Builds design tokens, CSS variables and component specs.
Styles interfaces with shadcn/ui and Tailwind.
Sets brand voice, visual identity and style guide.
Designs banners, ads and website hero images.
Creates logos, icons and identity assets (needs an AI image key).
Makes HTML presentation decks.
Animation best practices, spring generator and animation performance audit.
Reviews animation code for smoothness and performance.
Builds production-quality, accessible, responsive user interfaces.
Finds and installs ready-made React/shadcn components.
React patterns and best practices.
Makes React apps faster.
TypeScript patterns and safe typing.
Next.js app setup and patterns.
Search engine optimization for web pages.
Reviews React and TypeScript code.
Builds email templates as React components.
Node/Express/Next API patterns.
PostgreSQL schema, query, index and security patterns.
Prisma ORM patterns.
Writes the OpenAPI contract before the API code.
Consistent error handling across the app.
Safe, reversible schema, data and API migrations.
Stripe billing and subscription operations for the SaaS tool.
Reviews database schema and queries.
Builds fast APIs with Hono: routes, middleware, validation and tests.
Rules for writing and reviewing production Cloudflare Workers code.
Builds features that need shared live state, like chat rooms or live collaboration.
Neon database connections, migrations and per-branch test databases.
Sets up Prisma and connects it to the database (official, newer than prisma-patterns).
Reference for writing Prisma database queries correctly.
Adds sign-up and login to the app with Better Auth.
Sets up Better Auth sessions, database link and plugins the right way.
Email verification, password reset and password rules.
Team accounts, invites, roles and permissions for a B2B SaaS.
Official Stripe guidance on test setups, webhooks and integration choices.
Sends and receives email through Resend.
Keeps email out of spam: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, bounces and sign-up flows.
Adds background jobs that retry and survive crashes (option to Cloudflare Queues).
Writes scheduled and event-driven jobs with automatic retries.
Senior engineer persona who implements stories and code changes.
Builds a story or fix end to end: plan, code, review, verify.
Same as bmad-build but runs without stopping to ask.
Builds a feature with strict scope so it isn't overbuilt.
Builds a throwaway prototype to answer a UI or logic question fast.
Fixes a bug at the narrowest spot, with proof it stays fixed.
Restructures code without changing what it does.
Diagnoses an unclear failure before editing anything.
Fixes broken builds and compile errors.
Sets up, moves and deploys Next.js apps on Cloudflare Workers.
Runs and debugs Cloudflare Workers apps on the developer's machine.
Builds AI agents and AI features that run on Cloudflare.
React Native and Expo app patterns.
Flutter and Dart app patterns.
Native iOS apps with SwiftUI.
Native Android app structure.
Front door for Expo work: picks the right Expo skill for the task.
Screens and navigation in Expo apps.
Makes Expo screens look and feel native on iPhone and Android.
Loading data in the app: API calls, caching, retries and offline.
Builds the app and submits it to TestFlight, the App Store and Google Play.
Pushes quick fixes to installed apps without a new store release.
Writes the test first, then the code (red-green-refactor).
Plans test strategy, writes tests and checks coverage.
Tests the app in a real browser (DOM, console, network).
End-to-end tests with Playwright.
Runs and fixes end-to-end test suites.
Adds end-to-end and API tests for features that already work.
Proves work meets its acceptance criteria without adding scope.
Writes tests that throw thousands of random inputs at the code.
Audits and fixes WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility issues.
Reviews screens for screen-reader and keyboard use.
Finds and fixes slow front end, back end and database code.
Audits Core Web Vitals and page speed.
Audits page speed and Core Web Vitals.

Security reviewer focused on vulnerabilities and threat modeling.
Security checklist for auth, user input, secrets, APIs and payments.
Checks MCP configs for risky, unpinned packages before you approve them.
Blocks dangerous git commands like force-push and reset --hard (hook).
Six-phase security audit where every finding is independently re-checked.
Finds the security mistakes AI coding tools typically make (exposed keys, broken Supabase/Firebase access rules).
Security review of a code change or PR.
Maps what each function assumes and guarantees before hunting bugs.
Flags dangerous APIs, risky defaults and easy-to-misuse designs.
Checks every dependency for known advisories and supply-chain risk.
Runs a Semgrep security scan after showing you the plan.
Deep security scan that traces untrusted data through the code.
Confirms or rejects a suspected bug so you don't chase false alarms.
After one bug is found, hunts for the same bug elsewhere.
Scores how severe a vulnerability is (CVSS v4).
Audits GitHub Actions that run AI agents for security holes.
Scans agent skills for malicious or risky code before you install them.
GitHub Action that reviews every pull request for vulnerabilities.
Adds Cloudflare's bot check to forms, including the server-side check.
Puts admin tools behind Cloudflare Zero Trust login.
Adds two-step login (authenticator app, codes, backup codes).
Login security: rate limits, CSRF, secure cookies and secrets.
Clean branches, commits and merges.
Writes short, clear commit messages.
Sets up build, test and deploy pipelines.
Docker and Compose setup, including container security.

Adversarial review of a draft or plan: edge cases, gaps, structure.
